description: Frequency-bias check: how predictive is a permissive PTS1 C-terminus, and specifically -SKI, for peroxisomal localization across the reviewed yeast proteome
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

def fasta_parse(txt):
    out={}; k=None; b=[]
    for ln in txt.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if k: out[k]="".join(b)
            k=ln[1:]; b=[]
        else: b.append(ln.strip())
    if k: out[k]="".join(b)
    return out

r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":"proteome:UP000002311 AND reviewed:true","format":"fasta"},timeout=300)
print("HTTP",r.status_code,"bytes",len(r.text))
fa=fasta_parse(r.text)
print("S. cerevisiae S288c reviewed proteome:",len(fa),"proteins")

recs=[]
for h,s in fa.items():
    acc=h.split("|")[1]; gn=h.split("GN=")[1].split()[0] if "GN=" in h else ""
    recs.append((acc,gn,s[-3:],s[-1],s[-2],s[-3]))
P=pd.DataFrame(recs,columns=["acc","gene","cterm3","p1","p2","p3"])

STRICT=re.compile(r"^[SAC][KRH][LM]$"); PERM=re.compile(r"^[SAPCTNKQGV][KRHNQSM][LMIVFYA]$")
P["strict"]=P.cterm3.str.match(STRICT); P["perm"]=P.cterm3.str.match(PERM)
n=len(P)
print(f"\nproteins matching STRICT PTS1 [SAC][KRH][LM]: {P.strict.sum()} ({100*P.strict.mean():.2f}%)")
print(f"proteins matching PERMISSIVE PTS1:            {P.perm.sum()} ({100*P.perm.mean():.2f}%)")
print(f"proteins ending exactly in -SKI:              {(P.cterm3=='SKI').sum()}")
print("   ->", P[P.cterm3=="SKI"][["acc","gene"]].to_string(index=False))
print(f"proteins ending exactly in -SKL:              {(P.cterm3=='SKL').sum()}")
print("   ->", ", ".join(sorted(P[P.cterm3=='SKL'].gene.tolist())))

# how many yeast proteins are annotated peroxisomal matrix? use GO via UniProt
r2=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params={"query":"proteome:UP000002311 AND reviewed:true AND go:0005777","format":"list"},timeout=300)
perox=set(r2.text.split())
print(f"\nyeast reviewed proteins with GO:0005777 peroxisome: {len(perox)}")
P["perox"]=P.acc.isin(perox)
ct=pd.crosstab(P.perm,P.perox)
print("\ncontingency, permissive-PTS1 terminus x peroxisome GO:\n",ct)
odds,pv=stats.fisher_exact(ct.values)
print(f"Fisher exact OR={odds:.2f}, p={pv:.3e}")
ppv=P[P.perm].perox.mean()
print(f"\nPositive predictive value of a permissive-PTS1 C-terminus for peroxisome GO: {100*ppv:.1f}%")
ct2=pd.crosstab(P.strict,P.perox); odds2,pv2=stats.fisher_exact(ct2.values)
print(f"Strict consensus: PPV = {100*P[P.strict].perox.mean():.1f}%, OR={odds2:.1f}, p={pv2:.2e}, n={P.strict.sum()}")

P.to_csv("yeast_proteome_cterm_pts1.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
lab=["strict\n[SAC][KRH][LM]","permissive\n(incl. -SKI)","all other\nC-termini"]
vals=[100*P[P.strict].perox.mean(), 100*P[P.perm & ~P.strict].perox.mean(), 100*P[~P.perm].perox.mean()]
ns=[P.strict.sum(), (P.perm & ~P.strict).sum(), (~P.perm).sum()]
bars=ax[0].bar(lab,vals,color=["#2a7fbf","#f0a500","#9a9a9a"])
for b,v,k in zip(bars,vals,ns):
    ax[0].text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2, v+1.2, f"{v:.0f}%\n(n={k})", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% annotated GO:0005777 peroxisome")
ax[0].set_title("Predictive value of C-terminal tripeptide class\nin the reviewed S. cerevisiae proteome")
ax[0].annotate("AMD2 (-SKI) falls in this class", xy=(1,vals[1]), xytext=(1.25,vals[1]+16),
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#d1495b"), color="#d1495b", fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylim(0, max(vals)*1.45)

sub=P[P.perm].cterm3.value_counts().head(15)
ax[1].barh(sub.index[::-1], sub.values[::-1],
           color=["#d1495b" if t=="SKI" else "#2a7fbf" for t in sub.index[::-1]])
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of yeast proteins"); ax[1].set_title("Most common permissive-PTS1 C-terminal tripeptides\n(AMD2's -SKI in red)")
for a in ax: [a.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
